scientific_integrity: The exact row sums, unique conductance-ratio maximizer, and switching thresholds follow from an analytical spectral Green-kernel proof; finite rational computation is supplemental, not an infinite verification.
scientific_limitations: Only rectangular Cartesian products of complete graphs with positive weights constant on each edge direction; arbitrary weights and higher products are outside scope. Historical priority is provisional.
title: Sharp bounded-error amplification and direction switching on anisotropic rook graphs
